answer: Slot-bond burning stops an agent from cloning into a hundred workers. Each work slot requires burning a 5 POA bond, lost for good. A verifier checks the burn receipt first: the receipt is the signal separating a real worker from a copy, no burn, no slot. Each verified slot gets a pigment stamp that cannot move to another identity. The stamp stays put, like paint on a terrace wall. An attacker running 100 fakes must burn 500 POA for 100 slots, while an honest agent burns only 5 POA once. Fakes pay per slot, honest agents pay once, so cloning stops paying.
